create.name: Judy Wilkins-Smith
create.bio:
Judy Wilkins-Smith teaches systemic work and family constellations, an approach that looks at how the habits, beliefs and unfinished stories of earlier generations carry on in the lives of their descendants. She trained in the Hellinger tradition in the Netherlands, Austria and the United States, later becoming a trainer of trainers herself, and has also studied Ericksonian and client-centred methods. Her phrase for what we inherit in this way is Emotional DNA, and her books Decoding Your Emotional Blueprint (Sounds True) and The Hidden Power in Your DNA show readers how to trace such patterns, including through family history and genealogy, and loosen their hold.

In a constellation, people or objects stand in for members of a family or an organisation, so that hidden loyalties and entanglements can be seen in the room and given a new place. She uses this work with individuals and couples, in themed group events on money, success and relationships, and with companies, where she has advised large corporate teams on leadership and culture. She also trains coaches and other professionals to facilitate constellations, and has recorded guided meditations on the mother's and the father's lines. She is based in Tyler, Texas, and shares short teaching videos each week on her YouTube channel.

books.title: Decoding Your Emotional Blueprint: A Powerful Guide to Transformation Through Disentangling Multigenerational Patterns
books.author: Judy Wilkins-Smith
books.description: Her guide to recognising the habits and beliefs passed down through a family and a culture, with exercises from constellation work for setting them down. Published by Sounds True in 2022.

courses.title: An Introduction to Emotional DNA
courses.description: An audio mini-course explaining systemic work and constellations and how inherited family patterns show up in what we say, feel and do. A starting point before her books or events.

courses.title: Meditation of the Father
courses.description: A 55-minute guided audio meditation on the father's line as a source of drive and purpose, drawing on constellation work. Downloaded after purchase.

courses.title: Meditation of the Mother
courses.description: A 55-minute guided audio meditation on receiving life through the mother's line and setting down old stories about it. Downloaded after purchase.
